opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000; up to £750,000 in special cases by prior agreement; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not open to individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by schools or FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, local charities, or organisations not based in the UK (exceptional overseas cases possible).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (spring and autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based researchers and organisations; encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities, and partnership applications.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society in the UK. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK.

opportunities.title: Strategic Fund

amount.raw: Up to £15 million available; major grants typically in the range of £1-3 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations; not open to individuals without formal employment/relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, or establishment of academic posts.
opportunities.summary: Research grants for original, ambitious, transformative projects that confront the scale and urgency of the UK's biggest social and economic challenges and address one or more of the five priority questions.
